what:
**aide-memory-web docs structure: MCP tools and CLI commands live on a SINGLE merged `/docs/reference` page (decided 2026-04-28).**

Per user direction during the round-2 audit, the previous separate pages were merged:

- DELETED: `aide-memory-web/pages/docs/mcp-tools.mdx` (was 7-tool reference)
- DELETED: `aide-memory-web/pages/docs/cli-reference.mdx` (was 13-command reference)
- NEW: `aide-memory-web/pages/docs/reference.mdx`

**Structure of the merged page:**

1. "At a glance" table mapping each capability to its MCP tool name + CLI command (recall / remember / update / forget / search / list / import)
2. One section per shared capability, with the MCP form (parameters table + JSON example + response example) and the CLI form (command + flags + output) side-by-side
3. "CLI-only operations" section at the end for the commands with no MCP equivalent: `init`, `stats`, `recall-log`, `config`, `sync` (import / export), `migrate`, `cleanup`

**`_meta.js` order (post-merge):** `index, quick-start, concepts, features, configuration, reference, hooks, supported-editors, editors, architecture, troubleshooting, comparison, faq`. The reference page replaces the two old entries.

**Don't split them again.** Future content edits that try to add a new MCP tool or CLI command should land in `/docs/reference`. The user's reasoning: avoid repetition between two pages that mostly described the same operations from different angles. The single page reads cleaner because each operation's MCP shape and CLI shape are right next to each other, not on different pages.

**Internal-link chase rule:** if you grep for `/docs/mcp-tools` or `/docs/cli-reference` and find any reference, fix it to `/docs/reference`. Round-2 chased these in concepts.mdx, quick-start.mdx, index.mdx; they should stay clean. Editor pages (`editors/{claude-code,cursor,codex,copilot,windsurf}.mdx`) describe runtime UX and don't link to the reference page (they don't need to redundantly link).

**Repo-side mirror:** `docs/user/cli-reference.md` and `docs/user/mcp-tools.md` are still separate slim pointers, each linking to https://aide-memory.dev/docs/reference. The repo split was deliberate when those were ported (round-1) but is now slightly inconsistent with the web. If the next round of repo-doc consolidation happens, merge those two into `docs/user/reference.md` to mirror the web. Low-priority; doesn't affect users since both repo files point to the same web URL.
why: Major doc-architecture decision worth pinning. Without this memory, a future content writer (or me in a fresh session) could see "mcp-tools" and "cli-reference" as natural separate concerns and re-split, undoing the merge the user explicitly asked for. Also captures the by-capability section structure so additions land in the right place rather than appended ad-hoc. The repo-side note flags the unfinished consolidation so it doesn't surprise someone later.
